learning_objective: 🎯 We will read short stories and learn how to be smart detectives to find hidden answers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Comprehension means reading a story carefully and understanding what happens in it. It is like being a story detective.
After we read a story we get some fun questions. The correct answers are always hiding inside the sentences we just read!

fun_activity.title: 🕵️ The Story Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Read a very small story with your parents. Then let them ask you two questions about it to see if you remember the details!

quick_recap: ⭐ Comprehension is reading and understanding a text.
⭐ We must read every sentence very carefully.
⭐ The answers to the questions are always hidden in the story.
